Name: Froststar11's Simple and Clean Greenhouse
Author: froststar11
Description:
[color=red][size=3][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size][/color]

Welcome to Froststar's Simple and Clean Greenhouse - a no-frills (but still tasteful and minimally decorated) greenhouse layout that should meet all your basic farming needs for cash crops, trees, and trellis crops!
[line]
[b][size=4][u]How To Install[/u]:[/size][/b]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Download and unzip the mod file
- Copy the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods 
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!

[b][u][size=4]How to Uninstall:[/size][/u][/b]

- Delete the mod folder from your Stardew Valley/Mods folder. The game will revert to the original greenhouse layout.

[i]** Please note that this greenhouse is an expansion, so if you do not remove all crops, items, and decor from the area outside of the bounds of the default game's greenhouse before uninstalling, the objects WILL remain in place and be visible in the black abyss. I recommend completely removing all objects and crops from the greenhouse before uninstalling.

*** If you're switching to a different greenhouse mod, the same as above will be true - make sure you clean up your mess and have a blank slate in game before you swap to avoid any headaches![/i]
[size=4]
[/size][u][b][size=4]Potential Mod Conflicts:[/size]
[/b][/u]
This mod replaces the map for the interior of the greenhouse. Any other mods that attempt to do the same will not work with my mod. Otherwise, this mod should be conflict free, as it's an extremely basic Content Patcher mod.

[line][color=#429698][u][b][size=4]
Froststar's Open Source Maintenance Policy:[/size][/b][/u]

[i]﻿Please note that I have not been active in the SDV modding community for several years, and only check back at random when the urge strikes. If SDV gets an update that breaks this mod, I give my [b]full permission[/b] to anyone who wants to make a compatible version. You're welcome to share a link in this mod's Posts. Please just credit this original mod when doing so. [/i][/color]
